svg.title: Midnight Black Cat — fillable paint-by-number page
svg.desc: A proportioned black domestic cat with triangular ears, almond eyes, muzzle, paws, haunches, and a long curved tail, seated at a moonlit garden window. Full-color library preview; opening the SVG changes paintable regions into a numbered worksheet.
